'''Aargauese''' was, along with [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], one the [[Language/Legends|languages]] of the native peoples of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]]. The language was considered ancient by the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030807aargau|text=Aargau: For All Your Banking Needs|int=Aargau: For All Your Banking Needs}}</ref>
